entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: FY23 capital — senior center HVAC and town hall repairs. A building code change requires the senior center HVAC project to be rescoped with insufficient remaining funds; town hall repair funding's scope (interior vs. mechanical/furnace work) is unclear.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-08-04
entry.summary: A tour of TC Pacios and Brooks House with the Municipal Building Design Committee was scheduled for Tuesday, August 11th at 4:00 p.m., to be posted as a public meeting.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-08-03
entry.summary: Agreed to develop multiple options (renovating the current Ritter building plus a town hall addition, versus a new municipal building on one of several possible sites) with rough costs, and separately to develop options and rough costs for community reuse of TC Pacios.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Municipal Building Design Committee held an informal straw poll (not an official vote) concluding TCP likely has no remaining municipal use and should come down; committee also indicated it does not support building a new town hall given current school funding strain.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: Select Board asked the Building Design Committee to bring back a formal recommendation/vote on the disposition of Brooks House.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: Comparison demolition cost from prior project. Reference cost from previous municipal building demolition in 2023, used to estimate potential TC Passios demolition costs

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-07-27
entry.summary: Announcement of upcoming meetings: joint workshop with the Municipal Building Design Committee and Mass Save presentation; next regular meeting Aug. 4

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Planning Board, 2026-07-27
entry.summary: Example: town hall rehab cost framing (Westminster). As an illustration of how survey wording affects results, a member described a Westminster example where support for saving an old town hall flipped once residents were told the rehab would cost a specific amount.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-07-14
entry.summary: Hold a joint meeting with the Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee in mid-to-late August focused on TCP.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-07-07
entry.summary: Criticized years of lack of progress on municipal building projects and urged the select board to task the Municipal Building Design Committee with a holistic plan for all town buildings, citing the still-unadopted master plan as an example of the town's aversion to planning.

entry.title: Town offices: the municipal building plan: Select Board, 2026-04-21
entry.summary: New assistant town hall manager position. The commenter said the town manager's balanced budget adds a new assistant town hall manager position at an added cost, while eliminating one existing position.

entry.summary: Annual Town Report will display Town Hall photograph on front cover with School campus photograph on back cover, provided printer costs allow for both images

This older appropriation still exists and was not needed as a standalone project since it would roll into a municipal building redesign; the town manager plans to propose splitting it between project estimators and a stormwater utility study at fall special town meeting.
